updates.prompt: Match each adapted HSRP state description to its state.

sources: knows the virtual IP, is neither active nor standby, and listens for hello messages
forwards packets addressed to the group virtual MAC
is the candidate to become the next active router
sends periodic hellos and participates in the active or standby election
has not learned the virtual IP and awaits an authenticated hello from the active router

targets.label: Active
targets.expected: forwards packets addressed to the group virtual MAC

targets.label: Learn
targets.expected: has not learned the virtual IP and awaits an authenticated hello from the active router

targets.label: Listen
targets.expected: knows the virtual IP, is neither active nor standby, and listens for hello messages

targets.label: Speak
targets.expected: sends periodic hellos and participates in the active or standby election

targets.label: Standby
targets.expected: is the candidate to become the next active router

updates.explanation: 根据 Cisco HSRP 状态定义：Learn 尚未确定虚拟 IP 且等待活动路由器的认证 hello；Listen 已知虚拟 IP、既非活动也非备用并监听 hello；Speak 定期发送 hello 并参与活动或备用路由器选举；Standby 是下一活动路由器的候选者；Active 转发发往虚拟 MAC 的流量。原选项仅描述收发 hello，不能唯一确定状态，已补充状态特征。
